name: Switch
purpose: Lets users toggle a single setting on or off, with the change taking effect immediately.
neverUseFor: A choice that requires explicit confirmation before taking effect — use Checkbox + Button instead
Multiple mutually exclusive choices — use RadioGroup instead
Navigation between two views — use Tabs instead
rationale: Switch is for settings that apply immediately, exposed with role='switch' so assistive tech announces on/off rather than checked. Track and thumb dimensions are fixed per size (s 16px / m 20px track) by dedicated tokens, not consumer-configurable, so every toggle in the product looks and moves the same.

mayExtendLocally: Write the label and choose size s or m
Wire the change to product state
mustEscalateToDS: Adding sizes or changing track/thumb dimensions
Using Switch for choices that need confirmation before taking effect
Changing the thumb motion or color tokens

authored.name: disabled
authored.aria: disabled (native HTML attribute on the underlying button)

anatomy.description: Layout wrapper for the row and description.
Horizontal layout for the track and label.
The interactive element — role='switch', carries aria-checked.
The moving indicator inside the track.
Visible label text, linked via htmlFor.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hides the label visually but keeps it accessible via the label/button association — use when a custom heading elsewhere already displays it visibly.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text shown below the row.

props.name: size
props.description: Physical size of the track and thumb.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name — submitted via a visually hidden native checkbox kept in sync for form integration.

width.note: Track width is fixed per size (28px s / 36px m), not consumer-configurable. See --helix-switch-width-*.

properties.name: checked
properties.description: Thumb on the left (unchecked) or right (checked); the track takes the on fill.

properties.name: state
properties.description: Figma-only axis. hover/focus are CSS pseudo-classes in code (hover darkens the track: off-hover unchecked, on-hover checked); disabled is the `disabled` prop.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Show/hide part (show-hide-parts.md): the helper line under the row. It carries its own left padding (track width + 12px = spacing/250 on s, spacing/300 on m), so the row never moves.
